evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: Two matched negative clauses ('No blocking call, and no lost work') set in deliberate contrast — each negates a failure mode the contract excludes, forming an antithesis against the synchronous-loss paradigm.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Two matched verb-phrase alternatives ('polls the run' / 'gets the reaction piggybacked') arranged as a parallel either/or frame — grammatical symmetry across the two retrieval paths.
